summary: A short meeting notice from Jon Postel for a one-day meeting on Remote Job Entry protocols in the ARPANET, held at UCLA on April 21, 1972. Attendees were asked to read earlier reports by Alex McKenzie and Kampe from a previous RJE meeting. It also points to the data and file transfer protocols as relevant.

sections.title: A Meeting on Remote Job Entry
sections.content: Jon Postel announced a meeting to discuss Remote Job Entry (RJE) protocols for the ARPA Network. The meeting was scheduled for Friday, April 21, 1972, from 9:30 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. in room 2412 of the Ackerman Student Union Building at UCLA.
sections.plainLanguage: Network participants were invited to a full-day meeting at UCLA about Remote Job Entry. The notice gives the date, hours and room.

sections.title: Preparation and Related Protocols
sections.content: Attendees were asked to be familiar with earlier work on ARPANET RJE protocols, especially reports by McKenzie and Kampe from the previous RJE meeting. The notice also says the Data and File Transfer protocols were relevant to the discussion.
sections.plainLanguage: People coming to the meeting were expected to read earlier RJE reports. Data and file transfer were also part of the background.

sections.title: Confirming Attendance
sections.content: Prospective attendees were asked to contact Bryna Lang by telephone to confirm that they would attend. The RFC is a meeting announcement and does not set out protocol requirements or decisions.
sections.plainLanguage: Attendees needed to call Bryna Lang to confirm. This notice shares logistics, not the technical outcome of the meeting.
